ayahs.translation: Ha'. Mim.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الْكِتٰبِ الْمُبِیْنِۙۛ
ayahs.translation: By the Clear Book.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّاۤ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ فِیْ لَیْلَةٍ مُّبٰرَكَةٍ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُنْذِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We revealed it on a Blessed Night, for We were intent on warning;

ayahs.arabicText: فِیْهَا یُفْرَقُ كُلُّ اَمْرٍ حَكِیْمٍۙ
ayahs.translation: (We revealed it on the Night) wherein every matter is wisely determined

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْرًا مِّنْ عِنْدِنَا١ؕ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: by Our command. Verily, We were set to send a Messenger

ayahs.arabicText: رَحْمَةً مِّنْ رَّبِّكَ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِیْعُ الْعَلِیْمُۙ
ayahs.translation: as a Mercy from your Lord. Surely He is All-Hearing, All-Seeing,

ayahs.arabicText: رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا١ۘ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّوْقِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them: if you would only have sure faith.

ayahs.arabicText: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ یُحْیٖ وَ یُمِیْتُ١ؕ رَبُّكُمْ وَ رَبُّ اٰبَآئِكُمُ الْاَوَّلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: There is no god but He: He gives life and causes death. He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers of yore.

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ هُمْ فِیْ شَكٍّ یَّلْعَبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (But the fact is, they lack certainty) and frolic about in doubt.

ayahs.arabicText: فَارْتَقِبْ یَوْمَ تَاْتِی السَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِیْنٍۙ
ayahs.translation: So watch for the Day when the sky will come down with a pall of smoke,

ayahs.arabicText: یَّغْشَى النَّاسَ١ؕ هٰذَا عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: enveloping people. That will be a grievous scourge.

ayahs.arabicText: رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ اِنَّا مُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (People will then say): “Our Lord, remove this scourge from us; we shall believe.”

ayahs.arabicText: اَنّٰى لَهُمُ الذِّكْرٰى وَ قَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُوْلٌ مُّبِیْنٌۙ
ayahs.translation: But how will they take heed? Such are they that a Messenger came to them clearly expounding the Truth,

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَ قَالُوْا مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُوْنٌۘ
ayahs.translation: yet they turned away from him and said: “This is a well-tutored madman.”

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا كَاشِفُوا الْعَذَابِ قَلِیْلًا اِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُوْنَۘ
ayahs.translation: Yet We will hold the scourge back for a while, (but no sooner than We will do so) you will revert to your old ways.

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرٰى١ۚ اِنَّا مُنْتَقِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The Day when We shall seize them with a mighty seizing, that will be the Day on which We shall inflict upon you full retribution.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُوْلٌ كَرِیْمٌۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed before that We subjected the Pharaonites to the same test. A noble Messenger came to them

ayahs.arabicText: اَنْ اَدُّوْۤا اِلَیَّ عِبَادَ اللّٰهِ١ؕ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُوْلٌ اَمِیْنٌۙ
ayahs.translation: (and said): “Deliver to me Allah's servants. I am a trustworthy Messenger to you,

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنْ لَّا تَعْلُوْا عَلَى اللّٰهِ١ۚ اِنِّیْۤ اٰتِیْكُمْ بِسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِیْنٍۚ
ayahs.translation: and do not exalt yourselves in defiance of Allah. I have come to you with a clear authority (as a Messenger).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنِّیْ عُذْتُ بِرَبِّیْ وَ رَبِّكُمْ اَنْ تَرْجُمُوْنِ٘
ayahs.translation: I have taken refuge with my Lord and your Lord lest you should attack me with stones.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنْ لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوْا لِیْ فَاعْتَزِلُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: But if you do not believe what I say, leave me alone (and desist from laying hands on me).”

ayahs.arabicText: فَدَعَا رَبَّهٗۤ اَنَّ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then he called upon his Lord: “These are a criminal people.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَسْرِ بِعِبَادِیْ لَیْلًا اِنَّكُمْ مُّتَّبَعُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: (He was told): “Set out with My servants by night for you will certainly be pursued.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اتْرُكِ الْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا١ؕ اِنَّهُمْ جُنْدٌ مُّغْرَقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And leave the sea behind you as calm as ever. Surely they are an army that is doomed to be drowned.”

ayahs.arabicText: كَمْ تَرَكُوْا مِنْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّ عُیُوْنٍۙ
ayahs.translation: How many gardens did they leave behind, and how many fountains

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ زُرُوْعٍ وَّ مَقَامٍ كَرِیْمٍۙ
ayahs.translation: and sown fields and splendid mansions,

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ نَعْمَةٍ كَانُوْا فِیْهَا فٰكِهِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: and the life of ease in which they took delight!

ayahs.arabicText: كَذٰلِكَ١۫ وَ اَوْرَثْنٰهَا قَوْمًا اٰخَرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Thus it was; and We made another people inherit all that.

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَیْهِمُ السَّمَآءُ وَ الْاَرْضُ وَ مَا كَانُوْا مُنْظَرِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Then neither the sky shed tears over them nor the earth. They were granted no respite.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ نَجَّیْنَا بَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِیْنِۙ
ayahs.translation: Thus did We deliver the Children of Israel from the humiliating chastisement,

ayahs.arabicText: مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَالِیًا مِّنَ الْمُسْرِفِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: from Pharaoh who was most prominent among the prodigals.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدِ اخْتَرْنٰهُمْ عَلٰى عِلْمٍ عَلَى الْعٰلَمِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: We knowingly exalted them (i.e., the Children of Israel) above other peoples of the world

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اٰتَیْنٰهُمْ مِّنَ الْاٰیٰتِ مَا فِیْهِ بَلٰٓؤٌا مُّبِیْنٌ
ayahs.translation: and bestowed upon them the Signs wherein lay an evident test for them.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ لَیَقُوْلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed these people say:

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ هِیَ اِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا الْاُوْلٰى وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِمُنْشَرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: “This is our first and only death, and we shall never be raised again.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاْتُوْا بِاٰبَآئِنَاۤ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Bring back to us our fathers if you are truthful.”

ayahs.arabicText: اَهُمْ خَیْرٌ اَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ١ۙ وَّ الَّذِیْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ١ؕ اَهْلَكْنٰهُمْ١٘ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا مُجْرِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Are these better or the people of Tubba and those who went before them? We destroyed them for they were a criminal people.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا لٰعِبِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: It was not in idle sport that We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them.

ayahs.arabicText: مَا خَلَقْنٰهُمَاۤ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We did not create them except in Truth. But most of them do not know.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ یَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ مِیْقَاتُهُمْ اَجْمَعِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: The Day of Final Decision is the appointed time for all;

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ لَا یُغْنِیْ مَوْلًى عَنْ مَّوْلًى شَیْئًا وَّ لَا هُمْ یُنْصَرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: the Day when a friend shall be of no avail to his friend nor shall they be helped,

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا مَنْ رَّحِمَ اللّٰهُ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الرَّحِیْمُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: except those to whom Allah shows mercy. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Compassionate.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّوْمِۙ
ayahs.translation: The tree of al-Zaqqum

ayahs.arabicText: طَعَامُ الْاَثِیْمِ٤ۖۛۚ
ayahs.translation: shall be the food of the sinful.

ayahs.arabicText: كَالْمُهْلِ١ۛۚ یَغْلِیْ فِی الْبُطُوْنِۙ
ayahs.translation: Like dregs of oil, it will boil in their bellies

ayahs.arabicText: كَغَلْیِ الْحَمِیْمِ
ayahs.translation: like boiling water.

ayahs.arabicText: خُذُوْهُ فَاعْتِلُوْهُ اِلٰى سَوَآءِ الْجَحِیْمِۗۖ
ayahs.translation: “Seize him and drag him to the middle of the Blazing Fire,

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ صُبُّوْا فَوْقَ رَاْسِهٖ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْحَمِیْمِؕ
ayahs.translation: then pour boiling water over his head as chastisement.

ayahs.arabicText: ذُقْ١ۙۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْعَزِیْزُ الْكَرِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: Taste this, you are a person mighty and noble!

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ هٰذَا مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تَمْتَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: This is what you used to doubt.”

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِیْنَ فِیْ مَقَامٍ اَمِیْنٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Verily the God-fearing shall be in a secure place

ayahs.arabicText: فِیْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّ عُیُوْنٍۚۙ
ayahs.translation: amidst gardens and springs.

ayahs.arabicText: یَّلْبَسُوْنَ مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَّ اِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِیْنَۚۙ
ayahs.translation: Attired in silk and brocade, they shall be arrayed face to face.

ayahs.arabicText: كَذٰلِكَ١۫ وَ زَوَّجْنٰهُمْ بِحُوْرٍ عِیْنٍؕ
ayahs.translation: Thus shall it be: and We shall espouse them to fair, wide-eyed maidens.

ayahs.arabicText: یَدْعُوْنَ فِیْهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ اٰمِنِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: While resting in security, they shall call for all kinds of fruit.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا یَذُوْقُوْنَ فِیْهَا الْمَوْتَ اِلَّا الْمَوْتَةَ الْاُوْلٰى١ۚ وَ وَقٰىهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِیْمِۙ
ayahs.translation: They shall not taste death except the death in this world. And Allah will save them from the chastisement of Hell

ayahs.arabicText: فَضْلًا مِّنْ رَّبِّكَ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: as a favour from your Lord. That is the great triumph.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِنَّمَا یَسَّرْنٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), We have made this Book easy in your tongue so that they may take heed.

ayahs.arabicText: فَارْتَقِبْ اِنَّهُمْ مُّرْتَقِبُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Wait, then; they too are waiting.
